draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the pagination answer helped -- that ticket is closed on our side, so just say the word if anything else comes up there.

Since you mentioned still getting used to the layout: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Chidi
